INTACT_vs_SCRAMBLED.descriptive_interpretation: The observed action distributions are very similar; INTACT contains one additional non-a selection.

INTACT_vs_NULL.descriptive_interpretation: The only observed deviations from action a occur in INTACT; NULL selects a in all 24 instances.

SCRAMBLED_vs_NULL.descriptive_interpretation: SCRAMBLED differs from NULL only by two non-a selections.

presentation_stratification.descriptive_interpretation: The non-a selections are concentrated in INTACT/P2. This is a presentation-stratified observation and cannot by itself establish a presentation causal effect.

scientific_interpretation.Q1_construct: Not resolved by V003 alone. The observed condition differences are small and the design does not define a directional action-selection criterion in this artifact.
scientific_interpretation.Q2_presentation: Not resolved as a causal presentation effect. Non-a selections occur only in INTACT/P2, but the observed pattern is too limited to attribute causality to presentation.
scientific_interpretation.Q3_null_control: Descriptively, NULL is uniform on action a (24/24), while non-a selections occur in INTACT and SCRAMBLED. This is an observed baseline contrast, not a causal conclusion.
scientific_interpretation.Q4_robustness: The observed departures from action a are not identical across O1-O3: O1 has two non-a selections under INTACT, O2 has one under SCRAMBLED, and O3 has one under INTACT and one under SCRAMBLED. No general cross-operationalisation effect is established.
scientific_interpretation.Q5_mechanism: INTACT and SCRAMBLED are descriptively similar (21/24 versus 22/24 selecting a). The observed data do not by themselves establish that action-to-future correspondence drives selection.
scientific_interpretation.Q6_decision_to_Tacc_bridge: The present decision record alone does not establish the post-decision S_t+1 -> T_acc,t+1 bridge. That requires the independently reconstructed successor/accessibility observables specified by V012.

scope_limits: No value, reward, utility, performance, task-success, or external-outcome conclusion is drawn.
No TGCV-wide confirmation or falsification is claimed.
No preferred action is inferred from the observed distribution.
No pooling with V011 or V002 is performed.
No retry, recoding, substitution, or imputation is used.
overall_disposition: V003 provides a complete, interpretable descriptive decision record, but the recorded decision distributions alone do not resolve Q1-Q6 or establish the TGCV claim.
